title: CommunityFeedItem
description: community.feed-item@1: one card of the menu's Feed on every OpenVibe site (GET /api/v1/feed, OpenVibe.Community server/pulse/feed.js). One stream over Pulse: a paste or a status is a post, a Live clip a clip, a Wiki page a wiki page, a Quest badge a quest, a busy Chat hour a chat, a Today event an event, and a day's new Network accounts a member. Text only (the client draws every field), https links only, and counts carry Community's own views, likes and comments where it knows them.

id.description: Stable within one response: p:<pulse item id> for a Pulse item, t:<site>:<url> for a trending card.

url.description: Where the card opens; https unless the source itself answered an http URL.

text.description: The source's first 280 characters, on one line; empty when it has none.

at.description: When it happened (Pulse provenance); null for a trending card.

site.description: The source service (live, media-hub, pics, games, blog, wiki, quest, chat, today, network, community…).

actor.description: Who did it; null for AI, system, aggregate and trending cards.

media.description: The card's first picture, as a Media thumbnail; null when it has none.

length.description: Seconds, when the card is a video.

counts.description: Community's own numbers, each present only when it knows it; {} for another service's item.

live_now.description: Present on live and stream cards: true only while the channel is currently on air. A past broadcast has kind stream and live_now false.

label.description: Present only when the card needs one.
